## Projects

- [billing-api](https://github.com/amirjonss): subscription billing for SaaS on Symfony and PostgreSQL. Idempotent event log with a deduplication key and a RabbitMQ retry queue, so repeated payment webhooks never charge twice.
- [crm-lite](https://github.com/amirjonss): CRM for small teams on Laravel and Vue 3. Removed N+1 on the deals list with eager loading and a materialised summary table, bringing page time under 100 ms.
- [tg-notifier](https://github.com/amirjonss): notification bus on Symfony and RabbitMQ. Exponential backoff with a dead-letter queue so failed messages do not block the queue.
